snippet.title: KELDER – Official Trailer | Coming August 15
snippet.description:
Descend into KELDER, a psychological horror game where reality twists, rooms shift, and the walls whisper. Trapped in an ever-changing basement complex, you must uncover the dark truth hidden beneath an ordinary apartment block.

Explore. Survive. Lose your mind.

🕹 Launching August 15 on PC
🎮 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2973450/KELDER
🔔 Don’t forget to subscribe and hit the bell for updates!

What makes KELDER different?

Every playthrough is truly unique.

Dynamic, unscripted scares: No jumpscare will ever hit the same way twice — the entities adapt to keep you constantly uneasy.

You're not just exploring a haunted space — you're entering a sentient labyrinth that reshapes itself just to break you.
